🚀 We're Hiring: SOC Senior Verification Engineer (5+ Years Experience) 🚀

Are you passionate about SoC Verification and looking to work on cutting-edge technologies such as UFS, Ethernet, PCIe, and High-Speed IPs? We are looking for talented Verification Engineers to join our growing team!

🔹 Role Overview As a Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and driving the verification of UFS, Ethernet, PCIe, and other high-speed IPs at the IP and SoC level. You will work closely with architects, designers, and verification teams to ensure high-quality silicon delivery.

🔹 Key Responsibilities 
✅ Understand design specifications and define verification scope, test plans, and verification infrastructure.
✅ Develop and execute verification test cases to validate design correctness.
✅ Implement and analyze SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and coverage metrics (Code, Toggle, and Functional Coverage).
✅ Collaborate with architects, design teams, and pre/post-silicon verification teams.
✅ Debug complex issues and provide effective solutions.
✅ Follow industry-standard verification methodologies and quality practices.

🔹 Required Skills & Experience 
✔️ 5+ years of experience in the verification domain.
✔️ Strong experience in UVM, SystemVerilog, and C/C++.
✔️ Experience with IP-level and SoC-level verification.
✔️ Good understanding of processor-based SoC verification environments.
✔️ Hands-on experience with tools such as VCS, waveform analyzers, and third-party VIPs (e.g., Synopsys VIPs).
✔️ Strong knowledge of AXI/AMBA protocols and ASIC design flows.
✔️ Scripting experience with Shell, Perl, or Makefiles.
✔️ Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

🔹 Preferred Skills
⭐ Experience with UFS (Universal Flash Storage), Ethernet, and PCIe protocols.
⭐ Exposure to high-speed interface verification and complex SoC environments.
If you're interested in working on next-generation semiconductor products and challenging verification problems, we'd love to connect!

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated resume via direct message or email
keerkart@qti.qualcomm.com.keerkart@qti.qualcomm.com.
